mvp_description: AI-powered insurance policy summarizer for insurance agents

top_buyers.name: Kollhoff Insurance Agency
top_buyers.address: 4109 Lake Ave, P.O. Box 220, Ashtabula, OH 44004
top_buyers.fit_rationale: One of Ohio's oldest independent insurance agencies (founded 1828), family-owned with deep roots in Ashtabula. Represent multiple carriers. Would benefit from AI-powered policy summarization to quickly compare coverage options for clients. Their long history suggests they handle complex, multi-carrier policy reviews regularly.

top_buyers.name: Crawford Insurance Agency
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Locally owned independent agency serving Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio for over 80 years. Emphasize personalized service and comparing rates across carriers. Policy Pal would help their 10+ agents efficiently analyze and explain complex policy language to customers.

additional_contacts.name: Humphrey Insurance Agency
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Family-owned agency serving Ashtabula since 1935. Third-generation family business with strong community ties. AI policy summarization would help them maintain reputation for 'quality and personable service'.

additional_contacts.name: DRY Insurance Group
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Established 1977, operates 4 offices across Northeast Ohio with 21+ insurance specialists serving 8,000+ clients. Uses computerized rating systems and would benefit from AI tools to streamline policy analysis.

additional_contacts.name: Sposito Insurance Agency
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: 50+ year independent agency with offices in Ashtabula and Mentor, OH. Specialize in personal and business insurance with extensive local knowledge.

research_notes: Kollhoff Insurance has verified general email and direct agent email (jerry@kiagency.net). Crawford Insurance email needs verification. Ashtabula has a strong independent insurance agency cluster - good target market for Policy Pal.
